about: I'm Daksh, a computer science student at Arizona State University in Barrett, The Honors College, class of 2030. I like building for the web end to end: a React interface up front, Firebase behind it, and JavaScript or Python holding the pieces together.

I got serious about code in high school. I founded our coding club and competed in FBLA's programming events, where I placed first at state in Coding & Programming. I graduated as valedictorian of Sandra Day O'Connor High School. I'm Java certified, and Next.js is what I'm learning right now.
I'm looking for an internship where I can ship real features, get my code reviewed by people who care, and get faster at turning an idea into something people actually use.
